newsitem.title: USA: Lomak Petroleum sells $125 mln in notes. [CORRECTED 16:49 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Lomak Petroleum sells $125 mln in notes. [CORRECTED 16:49 GMT]

text.p: The following debt issue from Lomak Petroleum Inc was priced on Tuesday via Chase Securities Inc, according to market sources.
The deal was upped from an initial size of $100 million, to meet investor demand, market sources added.
